meta.name: fullscreen-dialog-portal
meta.description: 当 cook-web 页面在浏览器 fullscreen 场景下需要展示基于 Dialog 的支付弹窗、设置弹窗或业务弹层时，使用本技能排查 portal 容器是否落在全屏节点外。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发全屏页面时弹窗显示异常
copy.tagline_en: Debug portal container position in fullscreen dialogs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop fullscreen pages with mispositioned dialogs

howto.what: 装上后，当页面处于浏览器全屏模式时，Claude 会检查弹窗是否挂载在全屏节点内，并自动修复挂载位置，确保弹窗可见。
howto.when: 当 cook-web 页面在浏览器全屏模式下需要展示支付弹窗、设置弹窗或业务弹层时触发。

howto.what_en: When the page is in browser fullscreen mode, Claude checks whether the dialog portal is mounted inside the fullscreen element and fixes the mount point to ensure the dialog is visible.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a cook-web page needs to show a payment dialog, settings dialog, or business overlay while in browser fullscreen mode.
